metadata.title: fix: resolve flaky gateway creation Playwright test
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Fixes intermittent failure in `test_create_simple_gateway` (and related gateway creation tests) caused by a race condition between the DB commit lifecycle and page navigation
- The FastAPI `get_db()` dependency commits after the POST response is sent, but the JS handler immediately redirects via `window.location.href`, causing the HTMX-loaded gateways table to sometimes fetch stale data
- Adds `domcontentloaded` wait after POST, explicit gateways tab navigation after reload, and a retry mechanism in `_verify_gateway_in_table`

## Test plan
- [x] Ran the flaky test 5 consecutive times with all passes after the fix (was 2/3 before)
- [x] Fix applies to all gateway creation tests sharing `_submit_and_wait` and `_verify_gateway_in_table`

commits.message:
fix: resolve flaky gateway creation Playwright test

The test_create_simple_gateway test was intermittently failing because
of a race condition between the DB commit lifecycle and page navigation.

The FastAPI `get_db()` dependency commits the transaction AFTER the POST
response is sent, but the JS success handler immediately redirects via
`window.location.href`. This caused the HTMX-loaded gateways table to
sometimes fetch data before the commit completed.

Changes:
- Wait for `domcontentloaded` after POST to let the JS redirect settle
- Explicitly navigate to gateways tab after reload (tab state was lost)
- Add a retry mechanism in `_verify_gateway_in_table` to handle the
  rare case where the first reload still races with db.commit()

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
